author: Stahly
description:
Today I'm presenting what might be the coolest Gundam mecha kit out there, at least from a Warhammer fan's perspective: the Police Zaku from Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX. Massive armour, poster boy blue, and even a power axe. What's not to love about this design? In this showcase post, I walk you through my heavily weathered build.

The post The Police Zaku is the Gundam every 40k fan will love, here’s why (GUNPLA showcase) appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: The Police Zaku is the Gundam every 40k fan will love, here’s why (GUNPLA showcase)
